title: rev-ChIP Protocol for Chromatin Immunoprecipitation
author: Lorane Texari
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.vrbe52n

steps.title: Cell Lysis and Resuspension
steps.instruction: Thaw cell pellet on ice and resuspend cells in 500 µL of lysis buffer.

substeps.instruction: Note: For less than 500K cells, avoid 500 µL lysis buffer and tip sonication; use Covaris (130 µL) or PIXUL (60 µL) instead.

steps.title: Chromatin Sonication
steps.instruction: Sonicate samples for 7 cycles, keeping samples constantly cold to achieve a chromatin size range of 200-500.

substeps.instruction: Optimize cycles based on crosslinking method, cell line, or tissue type (double crosslinked DNA requires more rounds).

steps.title: Input Sample Preparation
steps.instruction: Transfer 10 µL of each sample into a new PCR strip for use as input.

steps.title: Lysis Buffer Dilution
steps.instruction: Dilute the lysis buffer based on the type used and split lysates if required for IP.

substeps.instruction: For LB3: add 55 µL 10% Triton X-100
For Metivier: add 750 µL Metivier Dilution Buffer
For RIPA: no dilution needed
Ensure diluted samples are well mixed.

steps.title: Input Sample RNase Treatment
steps.instruction: Add 68 µL of Elution Buffer (10mM Tris pH8, 0.5% SDS, 5mM EDTA, 280mM NaCl) and 1 µL RNase A to each input sample.

substeps.instruction: Incubate for 15 minutes at 37 °C.

steps.title: Input Sample Protein Digestion
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL of 55 of Proteinase K to each input sample.

substeps.instruction: Incubate at 55 °C for 1 hour
Incubate at 65 °C for 30 minutes

steps.title: Dynabeads A/G Preparation
steps.instruction: Capture Dynabeads on a magnet, remove supernatant, and resuspend in an equal volume of the appropriate lysis buffer.

substeps.instruction: For LB3: use LB3 + 1/9th volume of 10% Triton X-100
For Metivier: use equal volume of Metivier Dilution Buffer
For RIPA: use equal volume of RIPA buffer

steps.title: Antibody Binding
steps.instruction: Add the appropriate volume of Dynabeads and antibody to each ChIP sample.

substeps.instruction: For ≥ 100,000 cells: use 1 µg antibody + 10 µL Dynabeads
For ≤ 10,000 cells: use 0.1 µg antibody + 1 µL Dynabeads

steps.title: IP Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the IP overnight on a wheel at 4 °C (rotating at 8rpm).

substeps.instruction: Optional: Incubate at 4 °C for 1 hour for most antibodies with minimal data loss.

steps.title: Input Sample Bead Precipitation
steps.instruction: Prepare a mastermix of 2 µL 1 SpeedBeads and 120 µL 20% PEG8000/1.5M NaCl (8.5% PEG, 1M NaCl).

substeps.instruction: Mix thoroughly and add 122 µL of mastermix to each input sample.
Incubate at room temperature (RT) for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Input Bead Washing and Drying
steps.instruction: Wash and dry the input beads.

substeps.instruction: Wash 2x with 200 µL of 80% EtOH on magnet (move strip side to side 10x slow, 10x fast).
If using 4 PCR strips or less, vortex beads at speed 8 for 10 seconds.
Air-dry until cracks appear on the bead pellet (approximately 14 minutes).

steps.title: Input Elution
steps.instruction: Elute in 15 µL TT (0.05% Tween 20, 10mM Tris pH 8.0, cold).

substeps.instruction: Optional: Store at -20 °C.

steps.title: ChIP Sample Bead Washing
steps.instruction: Wash the ChIP beads using buffers supplemented with Protease Inhibitor Cocktail (PIC).

substeps.instruction: Prepare buffers by adding 10 µL PIC per 1 mL of WBI, WBIII, or TET.
Perform 3x washes with 180 µL WBI + PIC.
Perform 3x washes with 180 µL WBIII + PIC.
Perform 2x washes with 185 µL cold TET + PIC.

steps.title: ChIP Bead Resuspension
steps.instruction: Resuspend beads in 25 µL of cold TT.

steps.title: Input Supernatant Collection
steps.instruction: Collect beads and take 2 µL of each input supernatant (1-2 µL for 500K cells) for library prep.

substeps.instruction: Add 23 µL of TT to each collected input sample.

steps.title: End Prep Reaction
steps.instruction: Prepare a mastermix of 1.5 µL Enzyme Mix End Prep and 3.5 µL End Prep Reaction Buffer per sample.

substeps.instruction: Mix well and add 5 µL of mastermix to each sample.
Incubate for 30 minutes at 20 °C, then 30 minutes at 65 °C.

steps.title: Adaptor Addition
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL of Bioo ChIP Adaptors (10.625uM) to each sample.

steps.title: Ligation Reaction
steps.instruction: Prepare a mastermix of 15 µL Ligation Master Mix and 0.5 µL Ligation Enhancer per sample.

substeps.instruction: Mix well and add 15.5 µL of mastermix to each sample.
Incubate for 15 minutes at 20 °C.

steps.title: Ligation Stop
steps.instruction: Prepare a STOP solution mastermix of 4 µL 10% SDS, 3 µL 0.5M EDTA, and 20 µL water per sample.

substeps.instruction: Add 27 µL of mastermix to each sample.

steps.title: Salt Addition
steps.instruction: Add 4.5 µL of 5M NaCl to each sample.

steps.title: Proteinase K Digestion
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL of Proteinase K to each sample.

substeps.instruction: Incubate for 1 hour at 55 °C, then 30 minutes at 65 °C.
Alternative for FA-fixed: incubate for 30 minutes at 55 °C.
Optional: Leave at 4 °C overnight.

steps.title: Sample Bead Purification
steps.instruction: Prepare a mastermix of 2 µL SpeedBeads and 61 µL 20% PEG8000/1.5M NaCl (8.5% PEG, 1M NaCl).

substeps.instruction: Mix thoroughly and add 63 µL of mastermix into new tube strips.
Collect and transfer the supernatant of samples into these new tube strips. (Warning: DO NOT MIX PROTEIN A/G BEADS WITH SPEEDBEADS).
Incubate at RT for 10 minutes.

steps.title: First Bead Wash and Elution
steps.instruction: Wash and elute the samples.

substeps.instruction: Wash 2x with 200 µL of 80% EtOH on magnet (move strip side to side 10x slow, 10x fast).
Air-dry until cracks appear on the bead pellet (approximately 14 minutes).
Elute in 25 µL TT (0.05% Tween 20, 10mM Tris pH 8.0, cold).
Collect beads on magnet and transfer supernatant into new PCR strips.

steps.title: Second Bead Purification
steps.instruction: Prepare a mastermix of 2 µL SpeedBeads and 38.5 µL of [unspecified reagent] per sample.

substeps.instruction: Add 40.5 µL of mastermix to each sample.
Incubate at RT for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Final Wash and Elution
steps.instruction: Perform final purification of the library.

substeps.instruction: Wash 2x with 200 µL of 80% EtOH on magnet (move strip side to side 10x slow, 10x fast).
Air-dry until cracks appear on the bead pellet (approximately 14 minutes).
Elute in 20 µL of TT.

steps.title: Library Quantification
steps.instruction: Perform Qubit library prep using HS DNA buffer and standards.
